claims.claim: Lewis Hall es lateral izquierdo del Newcastle United
claims.note: The Week calls him 'left-back Lewis Hall'; the FA profile lists Newcastle United FC as club.

claims.claim: Nació el 8 de septiembre de 2004
claims.note: FA gives 08 September 2004; Newcastle gives 08.09.2004.

claims.claim: Nació en Slough, Inglaterra
claims.note: FA bio: 'Born in Slough'. Newcastle gives only the country, which does not contradict it.

claims.claim: Siete internacionalidades absolutas con Inglaterra, sin goles
claims.note: FA profile: Senior caps 7, Senior Goals 0.

claims.claim: A 2 de noviembre de 2026 tiene 22 años
claims.note: Born 8 Sep 2004, so 22 on 2 Nov 2026 by arithmetic.

claims.claim: Cesión de una temporada desde el Chelsea en agosto de 2023 con obligación de compra condicionada a criterios de rendimiento
claims.note: Article: season-long loan from Chelsea with obligation to buy depending on performance-related criteria. Criteria not specified in source.

claims.claim: Oferta inicial de 28 millones de libras, 7 millones en posibles complementos y comisión de reventa para el Chelsea
claims.note: Source: initial offer £28million, an additional £7m possible add-ons, sell-on fee owed to Chelsea. Source does not say the offer was accepted; the article already says so.

claims.claim: Debut con victoria por 8-0 ante el Sheffield United en septiembre de 2023
claims.note: Source: Newcastle debut was an 8-0 win at Sheffield United in September 2023.

claims.claim: Jugó 22 partidos en la cesión
claims.note: Newcastle profile: 22 appearances in 2023/24 (all competitions). pl-permanent-move also says 22 in all competitions. Correctly cited now.

claims.claim: El Newcastle fichó a Hall de forma definitiva procedente del Chelsea en julio de 2024
claims.note: Premier League article dated 1 July 2024 reports the permanent signing; Newcastle profile says permanent move July 2024.

claims.claim: Las fuentes no confirman el precio final del traspaso definitivo; los 28 millones son la oferta inicial de la cesión
claims.note: pl-permanent-move states no fee; beinsports-loan gives 28m as initial offer during the loan. Accurate.

claims.claim: Titular en cada partido de Premier League desde septiembre de 2024 hasta una lesión en el pie
claims.note: PA: 'starting every Premier League game since September'. Source gives no exact count. Article text does not name the injury month; source places it in February 2025 (article dated 5 Mar 2025, 'last month'). Naming February 2025 would be a useful addition, not a fix.

claims.claim: La lesión afectaba a un hueso del pie y le dejó fuera el resto de la temporada
claims.note: Source: foot injury to 'a bone in his foot', will need surgery, out for the season.

claims.claim: PA lo describió como uno de los jugadores más fiables del Newcastle esa temporada
claims.note: Source: 'one of Newcastle's most dependable players this season'.

claims.claim: Nuevo contrato largo de cinco años según se informó
claims.note: Source: 'reportedly five years in length', long-term deal. No end date or fee given. Article date is not shown on page; the 2026-09-11 date comes only from the URL slug.

claims.claim: 107 partidos con el club, ocho asistencias y tres goles
claims.note: Source: 107 appearances, eight assists, three goals for Newcastle.

claims.claim: Inglaterra anunció su lista para el Mundial de 2026 en mayo de 2026 y Hall no estaba en ella
claims.note: Article dated 22 May 2026: squad announced 'today'; Hall omitted.

claims.claim: Comentario que sostenía que dejar fuera al lateral izquierdo Lewis Hall podía ser un error mayor que dejar fuera a cualquier jugador de más renombre
claims.note: Quote matches: 'Not taking left-back Lewis Hall could prove to be a bigger mistake than the omission of any higher-profile player.' Unnamed outlet opinion; the article's 'un comentario publicado' framing is acceptable, but a named author would be stronger under the style guide.

claims.claim: FAQ: Sigue en el Newcastle; fichaje definitivo en julio de 2024 y nuevo contrato de cinco años según se informó
claims.note: Supported by the Newcastle profile and the contract article. Present-tense status rests on the Sept 2026 contract report; no contrary information found.

claims.claim: knownFor: internacional con Inglaterra
claims.note: FA squad profile lists senior caps for England.

valueNote: Short, plain Spanish with a clear timeline (loan, fee clarification, permanent move, injury, contract, World Cup omission) and an explicit note that the 28m figure is an initial offer, not a confirmed price. Mostly restates top results, so the added value is modest.
summary: All cited claims checked against opened sources and confirmed. The reviewer's earlier blocking issues (Chelsea age-eight claim, 22 appearances cited to the wrong source, single-goal claim against Manchester United, Howe/Hall quotes) are no longer in the body. Remaining notes are minor: the injury month is implied rather than stated, the contract article date comes only from the URL, and the The Week opinion is unnamed.
